source_input.field_warning: Fields ending in _jpy contain raw MT4 transport-account amounts and must not be interpreted as JPY. Their names are retained only because the input bytes are immutable.

currency_contract.usd_to_jpy_rule: Positive USD asset multiplied by contemporaneous USDJPY Bid; negative USD liability multiplied by contemporaneous USDJPY Ask.
currency_contract.close_bid_ask_reconstruction: Long close price is Bid and Ask=Bid+fixed spread; Short close price is Ask and Bid=Ask-fixed spread.
currency_contract.realized_pl_authority: Successive raw MT4 AccountBalance delta converted from inferred USD to JPY at the close event.
currency_contract.baseline_equity_authority: Canonical JPY balance plus price-based MTM of all baseline open positions.
currency_contract.candidate_equity_authority: Canonical JPY balance plus price-based MTM of candidate-accepted open positions only.
currency_contract.full_equity_open_cost_uncertainty: Bounded by maximum absolute close nonprice/conversion residual multiplied by maximum simultaneous baseline open-order count; the DD-reduction sign must be stable outside this bound.
